investment_theses.thesis: AI datacenter consolidation favors existing capacity over new capex; long XLK (tech select sector) and high-margin semiconductor equipment (MU) vs. short high-leverage neocloud debt plays.
supporting_signals: CNBC: 'How the midterms could fuel the K-shaped AI trade — raising the value of existing AI capacity while increasing pressure on debt-funded neoclouds'
CoinDesk: 'Bitcoin miner Riot could pay Anthropic 12% interest under $28 billion AI deal' — 12% rate suggests tightening capex financing
investment_theses.counter_view: Midterm Democratic sweep could accelerate clean energy and datacenter infrastructure spending; infrastructure bills may unlock new capex appetite regardless of rate pressure.
investment_theses.expression: Long XLK, long MU; short debt-heavy EV/AI plays (e.g., PLTR if trading on capex hype); hedge with long DXY for rate regime safety
